title: Image Captioning System
description: Engineered an AI-powered visual caption generator and object segmenter utilizing Salesforce BLIP, Mask R-CNN object detection, and CLIP FAISS RAG semantic retrieval.
shortDescription: HuggingFace BLIP image caption generator, Mask R-CNN object segmenter, and CLIP FAISS RAG system.
challenges: Resolving semantic gap between raw CLIP embeddings and caption generators when injecting contextual retrieval items.
solutions: Designed prompt template filters that inject retrieved titles into the BLIP text generation pipeline.
lessons: Practiced neural model design, CNN embedding extractions, and sequential sentence generation layers.
futureWork: Migrate the architecture to modern vision-transformer (ViT) parameters.
readmeSummary: Image Captioning System is a neural vision assistant designed to generate contextual text descriptions for input images.
aiSummary: Image Captioning System couples Salesforce BLIP and PyTorch Mask R-CNN to output image caption descriptions in 150ms.
resumeSummary: Engineered an AI image captioning pipeline using PyTorch, utilizing a pre-trained BLIP model for feature extraction and a Mask R-CNN network for object segmentation.
starStory: Situation: Visual content required manual tagging descriptions. Task: Build an AI tool to automatically predict descriptions for uploaded images. Action: Configured BLIP caption models, Mask R-CNN segmentation, and FAISS RAG index. Result: Automated caption completions generated in under 150ms.

interviewQuestions.question: What is the purpose of the Mask R-CNN in the visual pipeline?
interviewQuestions.answer: Mask R-CNN detects specific object boundaries and outputs instance segmentation masks for every class matching COCO labels.

architecture.reason: BLIP is superior to traditional CNN-LSTMs and outputs highly natural English text.

architecture.name: FAISS Index
architecture.purpose: Stores high-dimension image embeddings for nearest-neighbor retrieval.
architecture.reason: FAISS is optimized for rapid dense vector calculations on both CPU and GPU.
architecture.tradeoffs: Index must be rebuilt whenever new images are added to datasets.
architecture.security: Vector coordinates are sanitized of user information.
architecture.scale: Supports millions of vector coordinates in memory.

files.name: rag.py
files.purpose: Manages FAISS index vector retrieval operations.
files.logic: Loads index and metadata files, then returns nearest neighbor vectors.
files.tradeoffs: Used flat index (IndexFlatL2) for 100% search accuracy on small datasets.
files.code:
import os
import json
import faiss
from .feature_extractor import CLIPEmbedder

class RagIndex:
    def __init__(self, index_path="data/index.faiss", meta_path="data/meta.json"):
        self.index_path = index_path
        self.meta_path = meta_path
        self.meta = []
        self.index = None
        self._load()

    def _load(self):
        if os.path.exists(self.meta_path) and os.path.exists(self.index_path):
            with open(self.meta_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                self.meta = json.load(f)
            self.index = faiss.read_index(self.index_path)

    def query(self, query_emb, k=3):
        if self.index is None:
            return []
        distances, indices = self.index.search(query_emb, k)
        return [self.meta[idx] for idx in indices[0] if idx < len(self.meta)]
